Traveling with Apple devices usually means carrying a pile of charging cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank integrates everything you need into one compact charger, solving all your worries at once. It has built-in foldable prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. This is hands down my favorite travel accessory — it handles everything with ease, whether you need a quick top-up on the go or an overnight charge.

MagSafe Monday column: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest developments in MagSafe and the wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your Apple device's wireless charging capabilities.

Designed for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable prongs on the back, so you can charge the power bank itself without carrying a separate plug — just plug it straight into a hotel or vacation rental wall outlet. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I absolutely love this design!), which means you don't need to pack extra cables even if you want to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, or other devices.

Although I usually focus on MagSafe features for the iPhone, this power bank has a built-in 5W magnetic charging module designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low, just place it on the charger and easily top it up — incredibly convenient. It holds the watch firmly in place, so you can charge without carrying the original charger.

With a capacity of 10,000 mAh, this power bank has more than enough juice to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going for a full day of traveling. For me, the most practical feature is its 40W USB-C output, which can even give a shutdown MacBook Air an emergency boost.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you want to lighten your load when traveling with Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, an Apple Watch charging cable, and a USB-C cable all in one, with a minimalist design that slips easily into a backpack or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
